\"sword saint,\" and is a legendary
individual of the world they live in.
There is a maximum of only one Kensei in
any world.  A kensei has extreme skill
and expertise in all swords of all kinds,
and is very special.  Becoming a kensei
is a great honor that very few can ever
hope to qualify for.  A kensei is also a
legendary hero of outstanding
accomplishment, with qualities that are
unmatched and recognized by people of his
or her world.

<tjsInfo:
    Magic Blooded humans of the Ten
Worlds are a little different when
compared to the more often-found human
beings of the Ten Worlds are.\\LB
    Regular humans of the Ten Worlds are
descendents of mundane human beings of
planet Earth, which left their home world
centuries ago in a mass exodus where they
were forced to find a new place to live
for not only themselves, but all life of
Earth.  Space aliens known as architects
and their ten planets welcomed this life
of Earth, and to make a long story short,
ended up terraforming their ten worlds to
accept, keep, and take care of all life
of Earth origin for all time from then
on, as part of an arrangement the
architects agreed to and seemed to think
would be a good idea for not only
themselves but also life from Earth,
given some rather complicated
circumstances that needed solutions.\\LB
    Life of Earth, at that time, was out
of options and needed a place to live,
and the Architects needed their own
problems solved.  The spirit of Earth and
Earth's sun made a bargain with the ten
worlds of the architects, and so the
architects gladly transformed their ten
worlds to have breathable air exactly
like that of Earth, along with oceans,
lakes, and soil to grow crops and plants
in that would fully support all life
from Earth.\\LB
    The architects also permanantly
changed their own bodies and species,
becoming people who would live among
people from Earth, as fellow citizens,
and as their own species but resembling
human beings very closly, as friends who
agreed to forever after look after and
take care of all life from Earth.\\LB
    People from Earth were gifted with
a change to their spirits and their
nature, gifts from Earth and Earth's sun
that made humans forever onward magical
and having magic to their spirits, from
one generation to the next, and also
living on as not only enchanted humans
but also seperating into multiple races
of people that included humans as well as
elves, orcs, dragon people that looked
like humans, etc.  With these gifts,
people that were descendants of humans of
Earth to begin with had access to magic,
and abilities to cast magic spells, etc.,
while still having modern technology such
as televisions, computers, etc.\\LB
    Magic blooded humans are an offshoot
of Ten World humans that have a much
greater amount of magic to their nature
than ordinary humans do.  They find it
easier to cast spells and wield magic in
various ways, and their stronger
spiritual nature not only comes with a
boost to their magical potential, but
also an increase to their physical
strength, speed, and reflexes, and so on.
They also tend to be a much healtheir,
happier people who live better lives, and
can do more things than ordinary humans
can.\\LB
>
